The '''''Fortitude''-class assault shuttle''', also known as the '''Republic Transport Shuttle''', was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] utilized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The ''Fortitude''-class was largely identical to the [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle]], its predecessor from the [[Great Galactic War]], though the ''Fortitude''-class was slightly smaller. It carried individuals between Republic [[Space station/Legends|orbital stations]] and [[Planet/Legends|planet]] surfaces.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Fortitude''-class shuttle is identified as such in the Codex entry for the ''[[Lucky Lancer]]'', a [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle]] featured in the Trooper class storyline on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The ''Lucky Lancer'' is identical to ''Fortitude''-class shuttles, though it is slightly larger, but is still smaller than the 50-person [[NR2 gully jumper]] that appears in the ''[[Deceived]]''.

It could be crafted by players in ''The Old Republic'' as a large stronghold decoration item titled Republic Transport Shuttle.
